title: ground_candidates inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the ground_candidates tool (Analyze, Publish Data). Reference advertised name: honua_ground_candidates. Grounds a natural-language goal to a workflow family, ranked candidates, a draft intent, and an optional clarification envelope. See taxonomy.md §Intent and planning and planning.md §2.

goal.description: Freeform natural-language description of the operator's goal.

intentId.description: Intent identifier. Optional on the initial grounding call (server allocates one); required on a clarification turn.

workflowFamilyHint.description: Optional workflow-family override (one of the canonical WorkflowFamily names).

assumptionPolicy.description: Policy controlling when inferred assumptions trigger a clarification. See planning.md §2.3.

explicitInputs.description: Dataset, layer, or artifact identifiers the caller has already pinned.

areaOfInterest.description: AOI as WKT, bounding-box string, or named area.

spatialReferenceId.description: EPSG SRID for the AOI (defaults to 4326).
